message.content:
To find out the current time from the Windows Command Prompt you can simply type one of the following commands:

```cmd
C:\> time /t
```

or

```cmd
C:\> echo %TIME%
```

Both will display something like:

```
12:34 PM
```

If you want the time in a more precise format (including seconds), you can use:

```cmd
C:\> wmic os get localdatetime /value
```

which returns a value such as:

```
LocalDateTime=20241104123456.000000+120
```

From there you can parse the first 14 digits (`YYYYMMDDHHMMSS`) to get the exact hour, minute, and second.

Feel free to copy and paste any of those lines into your own Command Prompt window to see the current time on your machine.
